title: Maria Davidson
markdown:
Hi, I'm Maria! I currently live in San Francisco and run [Relational Capital](https://relational.capital/), a venture capital firm.

I grew in three different countries and studied at Oxford where I ran the Oxford Union. I decided to move to the US when I was 23 in search of the American dream. I started out as Joe Lonsdale's Chief of Staff at 8VC, and founded [Kojo](https://www.usekojo.com/) 2 years later which I ran for 8 years as CEO before becoming Executive Chair.

### Things I'm involved with and interested in:

- **Investing.** Investing in ambitious entrepreneurs.
- **Building.** Modernizing the construction industry with [Kojo](https://www.usekojo.com/), and building new cities with [Orascom Development Holding](https://www.orascomdh.com/).
- **California.** Making California the best place to live and work.
